name: Kitashirakawa Yuno
source:
A woman working as a dealer at a full-fledged casino.
She is a popular dealer with an active, and cheerful personality, full of mischievousness and charm.
She tries to act cool as a dealer, but when she gets excited about the game, her true face comes out and she starts to get excited about winning.
She is the daughter of an executive who belongs to a major company that has built a non-gambling, full-scale entertainment casino facility to spread the joy of casinos in Japan.
She is addicted to card games and the fun of winning, and works as a dealer herself to promote the entertainment of casinos as well as to enjoy herself.
